svg.title: Library Service — library management system and complete technology stack.
svg.text: A library management system covering catalogs, user accounts, reservations, loans, returns, fines and notifications.
Java 17 · Spring Boot · Spring Web MVC · Spring Data JPA / Hibernate · Spring Security / JWT
PostgreSQL database · Kafka events · Redis caching · MinIO / S3 storage
Docker Compose · Maven · Git · Swagger / OpenAPI · Postman
JUnit 5 · Mockito · Micrometer · Prometheus · Grafana · JavaMail / SMTP
